mission_meta.title: Circle of Trust
mission_meta.description: The Circle has a simple acquisition task. Retrieve R&D blueprints from a competitor. Corporate espionage at its cleanest.

briefing.email_body:
Greetings,

Your recent performance has come to our attention. The Circle requires acquisition of sensitive documentation from a competitor.

Target: Apex Innovations
Objective: Retrieve next-generation prototype blueprints from their secure R&D server
Compensation: 750 credits, with potential for ongoing contract work

Target specifications:
- Apex Innovation uses a hardened datacenter
- Blueprints are stored in their R&D division
- Standard corporate security protocols apply

Discretion is appreciated. This relationship could prove mutually profitable.

We look forward to a productive arrangement.

Regards,

Vesper
Acquisition Division
The Circle

sequence.description: Connect to Apex Innovations R&D server

on_start.speaker: architect
on_start.text: Corporate types. Polite, professional... and absolutely ruthless behind closed doors.

on_start.speaker: architect
on_start.text: They call themselves 'acquisition specialists.' I call them... well, let's just say they know the value of information.

on_start.speaker: architect
on_start.text: Vesper runs their Acquisition Division. Former corporate VP, now... whatever she is now.

on_start.speaker: architect
on_start.text: They're not as chaotic as NullPack. But that doesn't mean they're not dangerous, kitten~

0.speaker: architect
0.text: Vesper's brief... polite, professional. That's The Circle's way. They'll smile while picking your pocket, nya~

1.speaker: architect
1.text: Apex Innovations. One of the old tech giants. They've been around since before Oracle changed everything.

2.speaker: architect
2.text: Project Chimera. Neural interfaces. The kind of technology that could change everything... or destroy everything.

3.speaker: architect
3.text: $15M in R&D. That's what you're stealing. The Circle will make billions off it. Apex will lose everything.

4.speaker: architect
4.text: Done. The blueprints are yours. Or well, The Circle's. You're just the delivery mechanism, nya~

on_complete.speaker: the_circle
on_complete.text: Excellent work. The blueprints have been verified and our legal team is already preparing derivative filings.

on_complete.speaker: the_circle
on_complete.text: We at The Circle believe in recognizing talent. Your performance suggests you would be an asset to our ongoing operations.

on_complete.speaker: the_circle
on_complete.text: We will be in touch regarding future opportunities. We suspect this could be the beginning of a profitable relationship.

on_complete.reason: Helped corporate interests steal from another corp

on_complete.speaker: architect
on_complete.text: And just like that, you've done corporate espionage, nya~.

on_complete.speaker: architect
on_complete.text: Notice how polite they were? How professional? That's The Circle's way. They'll smile while they pick your pocket.

on_complete.speaker: architect
on_complete.text: Still... they pay well. And they protect their own. There are worse allies in this world.

on_complete.speaker: architect
on_complete.text: (quietly) Apex Innovations won't be the same after this. When The Circle is done with them, they'll be lucky to exist as a subsidiary...
